backend: Native Rust observer linked with original compiled game function crates
scope: Ordered first 1000 selected-state events plus the full battle terminal report; all original game methods and callbacks execute after recording stops. This is prefix qualification only, not later-event or exhaustive graph qualification.
rlibSelectionPolicy: Newest mtime per crate, only after the whole main release build finishes; all rlibs hashed before/after. This wrapper does not independently prove old rlibs came from current sources.

comparison.scope: Archived NDJSON prefix comparison only: every event payload and selected-state bit for the requested ordered prefix, its complete transitive snapshot closure, and the full battle terminal report are compared to the accepted complete trace. Later intermediate events are unobserved. Candidate exit code is caller-supplied; executable provenance, exhaustive graph coverage and throughput require separate evidence.
